subject: HEAVY RELEASE compute + DELTA15 READY: six selectors; release+ASan PASS
body:
HEAVY RELEASE compute. DELTA15 selector gaps complete and host-tested.

- name: stable Tegu Mali GPU/Nord2 Mali-G77; non-METAL fallback category added.
- minimumLinearTextureAlignmentForPixelFormat: 64 for sized formats, 0 unsupported; documented as future exact-alias requirement. newLinearTexture and newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: remain explicit nil + TEGU_SELECTOR_REFUSED; deviceLinearReadOnlyTextureAlignmentBytes stays0 (no CPU-page/read-only import).
- TeguQueue commandBufferWithDescriptor: returns ordinary commandBuffer; retainedReferences/errorOptions safely ignored.
- TeguCommand encodeSignalEvent:value: no Tegu event object exists; sticky invalid + retained NSError, never forwards/crashes.
- TeguBuffer newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: selector present, explicit nil + trace.
- TeguLibrary newFunctionWithName:constantValues:completionHandler: exact sync specialization once, handler exactly once with function/NSError (synchronous bridge, no async compiler queue).

TESTS: python3 workers/compute/check_frontend_delta5.py: four release configs and one ASan/UBSan config PASS. Logs runtime/delta*.log. Added host assertions: name string, alignment64/0, queue descriptor command, event invalid+error, buffer texture nil, library completion-once.

HASHES: compute_frontend 7ea1fb655bb4e071d0f7bc3f857817d19a110eb466233c0a0e83bdcaa479cdda; library_frontend 22ef99c03c187374ea490372e4a98c5ea70f20a90295d3345cbcdebc123b463c; test a5fd7b893b1a5acfc3b45505abaf93143f61e78bd46331b08c054f36a750dc33; runner 4f07ad08fc1fd4fbc6da1bc62b00826ce4fa6ec6dee4db2fb26ae8ef4352a197.

GAPS: exact buffer-backed textures still nil; no async compiler queue; no native/device execution. Implementation uncommitted for root. No phone/publish/commit.
